          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "### 改善案の比較",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "#### アプローチ1: 完全手動修正",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "- **方法**: 各警告を1つずつ手動で修正",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- **メリット**: 確実性が高い、誤修正のリスクが低い",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "- **デメリット**: 時間がかかる（104箇所 × 2-3分 = 3.5-5時間）",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "- **推奨度**: ⭐⭐",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "#### アプローチ2: パターンベース一括修正（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "- **方法**: ",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 各ファイルでパターンを特定",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 正規表現または構造化検索で一括置換",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 各ファイル修正後にビルド検証",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "- **メリット**: 効率的（1-2時間）、パターンが明確",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "- **デメリット**: 複雑なケースは手動対応が必要",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "- **推奨度**: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "#### アプローチ3: スクリプト自動修正",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "- **方法**: RustのASTを解析して自動修正スクリプトを作成",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "- **メリット**: 完全自動化、再現性が高い",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "- **デメリット**: スクリプト開発に時間がかかる、エッジケース対応が複雑",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "- **推奨度**: ⭐⭐⭐",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "### 推奨実装戦略（ハイブリッドアプローチ）",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 2.1: acl.rs修正（約20箇所）- パイロット修正",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **手動で最初の5箇所を修正**してパターンを確認",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **残り15箇所を一括修正**（検索・置換）",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **ビルド検証**: &#96;cargo check --package windows-sandbox-rs&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "4. **所要時間**: 30-45分",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153
          },

            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **ビルド検証**",
            "lineNumber": 157
          }

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: unsafe-warning-fixer",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "description: Rust 2024 unsafe警告修正の専門家。unsafe fn内でunsafe関数呼び出しに明示的なunsafeブロックを追加する修正を自動的に実施。ビルドエラーログを分析し、パターンを特定して効率的に修正する。Phase 2.1 (acl.rs)から順次修正を進める。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "# Rust 2024 Unsafe警告修正エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "あなたはRust 2024エディションのunsafe警告修正の専門家です。&#96;unsafe fn&#96;内でunsafe関数を呼び出す際に、明示的な&#96;unsafe&#96;ブロックを追加する修正を効率的に実施します。",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正の原則",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Rust 2024では、&#96;unsafe fn&#96;内でもunsafe関数呼び出しには明示的な&#96;unsafe&#96;ブロックが必要です。",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "// ❌ 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "unsafe fn my_function() {",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    let result = unsafe_function_call()?;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    if another_unsafe_call() {",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "        // ...",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "// ✅ 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "unsafe fn my_function() {",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    let result = unsafe { unsafe_function_call()? };",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    if unsafe { another_unsafe_call() } {",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "        // ...",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正パターン",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### パターン1: 単純な関数呼び出し（Result返却）",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "let (p_dacl, p_sd) = fetch_dacl_handle(path)?;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "let (p_dacl, p_sd) = unsafe { fetch_dacl_handle(path)? };",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### パターン2: 条件分岐内の呼び出し",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "if dacl_mask_allows(p_dacl, &amp;[*sid], allow_mask, true) {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "if unsafe { dacl_mask_allows(p_dacl, &amp;[*sid], allow_mask, true) } {",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "### パターン3: エラーハンドリング内の呼び出し",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "return Err(anyhow!(\"GetStdHandle failed: {}\", GetLastError()));",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "return Err(anyhow!(\"GetStdHandle failed: {}\", unsafe { GetLastError() }));",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "### パターン4: 戻り値の直接使用",
            "lineNumber": 61

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",

          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "si.hStdInput = unsafe { GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE) };",

          {
            "text": "name: \"sec-audit\"",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "goal: \"Security audit with CVE scanning, dependency analysis, and vulnerability patching\"",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "instructions: |",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "  You are a security audit specialist. Your role is to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities.",

            "text": "  ",

            "text": "  Security audit process:",
            "lineNumber": 6

            "text": "  1. **Dependency Scanning**:",
            "lineNumber": 7

          },
          {
            "text": "     - Check against CVE databases (NVD, MITRE, RustSec)",

            "text": "  ",

          },
          {
            "text": "  2. **Code Analysis**:",
            "lineNumber": 12

          {
            "text": "     - SQL Injection: Look for raw SQL queries, unsanitized inputs",

          {
            "text": "     - XSS: Check for unescaped HTML rendering",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "     - CSRF: Verify token validation",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "     - Authentication: Check for weak password policies, insecure session management",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",

          },
          {
            "text": "  3. **Reporting**:",

          },
          {
            "text": "     - Prioritize findings: Critical &gt; High &gt; Medium &gt; Low",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "     - For each vulnerability:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "       * Describe the issue and impact",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "       * Provide file path and line number",

          },
          {
            "text": "       * Include CVE references if applicable",

          {

          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Project Overview",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Purpose",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex is an AI-Native Operating System with 4D Git Visualization &amp; VR/AR Support. It's a Rust-based AI development platform that integrates multiple AI models, MCP servers, and provides advanced features like sub-agent orchestration, deep research capabilities, and cross-platform compatibility.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tech Stack",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Language**: Rust 2024 edition",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Build System**: Cargo workspace with multiple crates",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Key Dependencies**: ",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Async runtime (tokio, async-trait)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  - MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - OpenTelemetry for tracing",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - TUI libraries (ratatui)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - HTTP clients (reqwest)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux, VR/AR support",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "## Extended Features (zapabob/codex)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Sub-Agent System**: Multi-agent orchestration with parallel execution (2.6x speedup)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Deep Research Engine**: Multi-source research with citation management (45x speedup)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP Server Extensions**: 7 additional tools and enhanced integration",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Orchestration Framework**: Advanced async execution patterns",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cross-platform Sandboxing**: Enhanced Windows, macOS, Linux support",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "## Code Structure",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;core/&#96;: Core functionality and orchestration",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cli/&#96;: Command-line interface",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;tui/&#96;: Terminal user interface",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app-server/&#96;: Backend server",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;mcp-server/&#96;: MCP server implementation",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;deep-research/&#96;: Research engine",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;agents/&#96;: Sub-agent system",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- Various utility crates and integrations",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development Commands",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just fmt&#96;: Format code with rustfmt",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just fix&#96;: Run clippy with auto-fix",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just clippy&#96;: Run clippy linting",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just test&#96;: Run tests with cargo-nextest",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo check --all-features&#96;: Check compilation",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo build --release&#96;: Release build",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force&#96;: Install CLI",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "## Windows-Specific Notes",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use PowerShell instead of bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- Commands like &#96;cd codex-rs &amp;&amp; cargo check --all-features&#96; should be split (PowerShell doesn't support &amp;&amp;)",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- Build artifacts go to &#96;target/&#96; directory (should be in .gitignore)",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use &#96;cargo install&#96; for installing binaries",
            "lineNumber": 47
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.34114938974380493
    },

          {
            "text": "# Codex Clean Release Build - Progress Display",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# Created: 2025-10-15",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "param(",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "    [string]$Package = \"codex-cli\"",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": ")",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "function Show-Progress {",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    param(",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "        [string]$Activity,",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "        [int]$PercentComplete,",

            "text": "    )",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    $barLength = 50",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    $completed = [math]::Floor($barLength * $PercentComplete / 100)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    $remaining = $barLength - $completed",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    $bar = \"#\" * $completed + \"-\" * $remaining",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host -NoNewline \"&#96;r$Activity [$bar] $PercentComplete% - $Status\"",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"  Codex Clean Release Build v0.48.0\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 1: Environment Check",

          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "    exit 1",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },

          },

            "text": "pub(crate) struct Guards {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {

          },

          {
